tests.name: python extraction: functions carry complexity, nesting and location; nested functions stand alone
complexity: warning at the warning thresholds, info below them, nothing under info
complexity: thresholds come from the config, level by level
complexity: a threshold that is not a whole number names the setting and stops
complexity: a valid threshold still overrides just that one value
complexity: a warning threshold set below the info threshold still reports the function
complexity: not run, and not listed as checked, when functions were not measured
complexity: the id follows the function, and the digest only its own lines
complexity: the overlay ties a function to its component and adds an indicator there only
complexity: end to end on a Python tree
ts extraction: functions, methods, named arrows and module-scope callbacks; inner callbacks fold in
ts and python: the same logic gets the same complexity and nesting
complexity: runs for JS/TS projects end to end
ts extraction: module-scope callbacks are named by their call and literal, not their position
ts extraction: syntax errors are recorded as parse_errors
check: the summary shows a parse failure and a language that was not analyzed
check: a clean run says nothing about coverage and the gate is unchanged
check: threshold errors stay errors and partial coverage does not change the finding gate

check: the text summary escapes control characters in parse-failure paths
